steps: Visit the official portal and click on Register.
Choose either Jan Aadhaar or Google to process registration.
Log in and click on RAJ-KISAN on the dashboard.
Select Farmer and click on Application Entry Request.
Enter Bhamashah ID or Janaadhaar ID and search.
Provide required details, upload documents, and submit.
